description: Workflow primitive that pauses the run and waits for a human to click Approve or Reject. Approve forwards the upstream payload downstream; Reject cancels the whole run with the captured comment. No subprocess — the runner handles the pause/resume in-process.

wait.description: Pause the workflow at this node and wait for a human to click Approve or Reject in the run detail page. Approve forwards the upstream payload to downstream nodes; Reject cancels the whole run with the comment captured. The optional 'prompt' field is the question shown to the human.
